summary: Sidus Space Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 1.01, 8.01, 9.01) on April 20, 2026, disclosing entry into a Placement Agency Agreement with ThinkEquity LLC. The agreement involves a best-efforts offering of 11,228,700 shares at $4.35/share and 2,225,000 pre-funded warrants at $4.3499 each, expecting ~$58.5M gross proceeds. This is an ordinary equity raise under an effective S-3 shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing is a routine current report for a capital raise, with net proceeds for working capital. No special-situation trigger is present; the offering is standard and lacks terms such as premiums, board recommendations, or strategic changes.
